sources.claim: EARS notation adopted by Airbus, Bosch, NASA, Siemens; reduces ambiguity in requirements

sources.title: Best AI Meeting Notetakers — Alfred
sources.claim: Summaries sitting in standalone apps nobody returns to is the critical weakness of AI meeting tools

sources.claim: AI can save Product Owners up to 10 hours a week; backlog management consumes ~20% of a PO's workweek

sources.title: AI Project Reports — Taskade
sources.claim: Project managers spend 3–5 hours/week on status reports (~200 hours/year) that stakeholders skim in under 2 minutes

sources.title: AI Report Generation — Improvado
sources.claim: Teams with integrated data pipelines report 30–50% reduction in report creation time

sources.title: PRD for AI Code Generation — ChatPRD

sources.claim: Jira Rovo can extract backlog items from Confluence, Slack, email, and images

sources.claim: GitHub Copilot can be assigned to backlog issues, enabling autonomous code generation from well-written acceptance criteria

sources.title: Fireflies.ai — AI Meeting Notes
sources.claim: Fireflies supports 60+ languages and automatically pushes meeting notes into CRM and project management tools

sources.title: Three Amigos — Agile Alliance

sources.title: User Story Splitting Patterns — Humanizing Work

sources.claim: Product owners can use structured prompts to prioritise, split stories, generate ACs, and run risk analysis
